quote: Own FY2018 10-K BS, Aug. 31, 2018: "Receivables from clients, net | 4,996,454"; "Unbilled services, net | 2,499,914". The FY2019 10-K (ASC 606) prints Aug. 31, 2018 as "Receivables and contract assets | 7,496,368" = 4,996,454 + 2,499,914, a wider line holding contract assets; the shown 7,496,368 is that combined later copy.
rule_proposal: none needed beyond a later-copy rule: a later copy printed under a wider total is not the cell (inverse of the 2026-11-17 part ruling)

quote: FY2026 10-K tags CommonStockDividendsPerShareCashPaid = 1.63 at each of 2025-11-14, 2026-02-13, 2026-05-15 and 2026-08-14 (the four FY2026 payments) and prints no annual per-share total; FY2025 10-K printed the annual 5.92 (= 4 x 1.48). 4 x 1.63 = 6.52.
rule_proposal: dps_sum_of_printed_payments: when the 10-K prints one per-share amount per payment date inside the fiscal year and no annual figure, DPS = the sum of those printed amounts (same filing, same share basis); not EPS, so derivation from printed same-filing facts is allowed as for Q4 DPS (founder 2026-11-04 item 2)

quote: Latest 10-K presenting FY2017 (FY2019 10-K, ASC 606 restated): "Revenues | 36,176,841"; "Cost of services | 25,105,349"; "Sales and marketing | 3,752,313"; "General and administrative costs | 2,127,777"; "Total operating expenses | 30,985,439"; "OPERATING INCOME | 5,191,402". Opex = 3,752,313 + 2,127,777 = 5,880,090 = (36,176,841 - 25,105,349) - 5,191,402. The printed "Total operating expenses" includes cost of services (the ancestor the mapper held on).
rule_proposal: none needed: one vintage per year (latest print) + C1 tie
